items.t: CLNE Q3 2026 deep dive: tax credits and new engine adoption drive outperformance
items.sum: Alternative fuel provider Clean Energy Fuels (NASDAQ:CLNE) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.7% year on year to $112.2 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.03 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.t: Why Clean Energy Fuels (CLNE) stock is trading up today
items.sum: Shares of alternative fuel provider Clean Energy Fuels (NASDAQ:CLNE) jumped 26.3% in the afternoon session after the company reported third-quarter financial results that came in above Wall Street estimates.

items.t: Dole Posts Downbeat Q3 Results, Joins NVIDIA And Other Big Stocks Moving Lower In Monday’s Pre-Market Session
items.sum: U.S. futures rose, but Dole fell 8.3% after missing Q3 estimates. CEVA, CYPH, CLNE, SMRT, OBX, ASST, NVDA and BMNR also declined premarket.
